messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — I need to swap my oncall slot this Sat (2026-05-08) evening block 6pm-12am PST. Family thing, short notice. Can anyone pick up the full block? I can trade a weekday next week (Mon-Fri).
Mia Patel: I can take 8-12 but not 6-8 :+1:
Ryan O'Neill: I can do 6-10 but need to check travel for 10-12. If Jordan can cover 10-12 that works.
Jordan Lee: I can cover 10-12. +1 to Ryan taking 6-10.
Alex Chen: Thanks — sounds like stacking would be: Ryan 6-10, Mia 8-12 (overlap 8-10), Jordan 10-12. Still need someone for 6-8 if Ryan wants a break at 8 — Ryan you said you can do 6-10 so that blocks 6-8 covered.
Ryan O'Neill: Yeah I can do the full 6-10. Confirmed.
Alex Chen: OK I'll update the calendar. Quick handoff notes (copied below) — please read before taking the slot and paste any follow-ups here. I'll also add this to the oncall doc.
Alex Chen: Handoff notes:
- Scope: evening oncall for inference runtime (model serving, routing, autoscale, KV-cache issues).
- Current active work: rolling kernel upgrade scheduled Sat 9:00pm PST (see infra ticket #INF-1423). Expected short-lived latency spikes during pod restarts; autoscale policy should keep tails < 60s but watch the latency alerts.
- Known flaky alert: `latency_p50_ms` sometimes jumps for small-v2 under 1k tokens when batch size spikes — if you see continuous >2m, restart the router pod in us-west-2.
- Temporary mitigations: fallback routing enabled to `small-v2` and `small-v2-quant` at 2% traffic; if errors >5% flip to 10% via the console route toggles.
- Who to contact: Sam K (infra) for kernel/rolling upgrades, Tasha M (platform PM) for rollout questions. On Slack: @samk @tasham.
- Useful commands:
```
# check inference pods
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
# tail runtime logs
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=inference -c runtime --tail=200
# quick health check
redwood infra status --region us-west-2
```
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference
- Calendar: I've updated the oncall calendar entry and marked me as swapping out. Please also add an emoji reaction once you're confirmed.
Mia Patel: One more note — we're running an eval sweep against reranker-prod this Sat 7pm-8pm which may temporarily increase embedding requests. Expect short CPU pressure on embedding workers. If you see memory OOMs, scale embeddings pool to +2 replicas.
Alex Chen: Good call, Mia. Added that under "active work". Thanks.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Please log oncall swaps in the oncall calendar and update the swap tracker: https://redwood.internal/oncall/swap-tracker
Tasha M: Thanks for the heads up. FYI infra will be watching the 9pm kernel upgrade; Sam, please ping here when upgrade begins.
Sam K: Will do — I'll post start/complete. ETA for upgrade is ~20-30m but may need pogo restarts.
Jordan Lee: Confirming I’ll cover 10-12. Adding reaction now.
Ryan O'Neill: Confirming 6-10. Added :white_check_mark:
Mia Patel: Confirming 8-12. Added :raised_hands:
Alex Chen: Thanks all — calendar updated, swap tracker updated, handoff pinned in thread. Appreciate the covers. I'll DM anyone offline details if needed.
